subject: Computer Science
instructions:
Security talk: SQL injection.
Your talk needs to:
- Define what a SQL injection attack is
- Show a vulnerable query with an example attack string
- Present two defenses
- Describe one real-world breach caused by SQL injection
draft:
A SQL injection attack happens when user input is pasted into a database query, so the attacker's text runs as part of the command.
Example: the code builds "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + input + "'". If the input is ' OR '1'='1 then the query returns every user.
The main defense is parameterized queries, where the database treats the input only as a value and never as code.
notes: One of two defenses; no real-world breach.
